title: GOP Sen. Jon Husted wins an unusual endorsement — from Steak ’n Shake
description: The Midwestern fast food chain praised the Ohio Republican as a champion of the Trump administration’s “Make America Healthy Again” movement.

title: The Senate returns Monday. It’s not clear if McConnell will be back.
description: The Kentucky Republican has not returned to the chamber since he suffered a fall three months ago.

title: Working-class Americans aren’t running for office. It’s changing our politics.
description: It is having a direct impact on the kind of public policy coming out of the nation’s legislative bodies.

title: A barrage of cases hitting the Supreme Court is stirring midterm confusion
description: The number of election-related lawsuits is exploding — and the courts are still resolving them just weeks before the elections.

title: Trump, Vance open midterm campaign tour as GOP troubles deepen
description: The president and vice president are trying to rescue Senate candidates in North Carolina and Kansas, states Republicans carried two years ago.

title: A centrist House Democrat may be replaced by ‘Trump before Donald Trump’
description: Former Maine governor Paul LePage is seen as the likely winner against progressive Matt Dunlap in the race for retiring Rep. Jared Golden’s seat.

title: In this red state, backlash erupts over president’s threat to ban major employer
description: Several Wichita-based Bombardier employees said the post felt to them as though the president was turning his back on American workers.

title: What to know about Trump’s proposed $5,000 payouts
description: The president has pledged direct payments to Americans several times since returning to office.

title: Texas Rep. Greg Casar discusses bill to temporarily pause advanced AI development
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with U.S. Rep. Greg Casar, D-Texas, about his efforts to regulate artificial intelligence.

title: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
description: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

title: Local election officials are training to defend the midterms from interference
description: Hundreds of election officials from around the country are meeting to discuss how to defend the integrity of the midterm elections, including against interference by the federal government.federal government.

title: Trump returns home to drum up voter support for GOP candidates ahead of midterms
description: President Trump returns to the U.S. ready to rally on behalf of Republican candidates as the midterm election enters its crucial fall stretch.

title: Republican pollster discusses GOP voters' outlook as midterms approach
description: NPR's Leila Fadel checks in on GOP voters' outlook with Republican pollster Jim Hobart of Public Opinion Strategies.

title: Lawmakers hone in on midterm messages as Congress returns to session
description: Congress returns for a short last session ahead of the midterm election with a full plate as lawmakers look for messaging bills they can take back to voters.

title: Pennsylvania woman died from complications of probable measles case, coroner says
description: The coroner said the unvaccinated 40-year-old woman exhibited many common symptoms of measles, such as a fever, cough, white spots inside the mouth and a rash.

title: Trump resists AI slowdown as the political tide turns
description: Democrats are increasingly attacking the administration’s hands-off approach to artificial intelligence regulation as midterms approach.

title: Trump downplays calls for AI slowdown
description: President Trump said the dire warnings about AI were exaggerated and that "negative forces" are making claims about things that won't happen. This comes after leaders in the industry called for putting the brakes on AI development.

title: Wisconsin lawmaker says he swam to safety after emergency plane landing
description: Rep. Tom Tiffany, the GOP nominee for governor, said the pilot made an emergency water landing after the plane lost power and they both swam to safety.

title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
description: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

title: This candidate won a stunning upset. His life before that is even less likely.
description: David Crowley had a surprising path to becoming his party’s nominee for governor of Wisconsin. His life before that was even more unlikely.

title: The new threat election officials fear: Trump’s federal government
description: With seven weeks until Election Day, officials are preparing for seized ballots, troops at the polls and a postal system that could reject ballots by the batch.

title: We asked dozens of people what they want from Democrats. Here’s what they said.
description: At a rest stop off Interstate 95, voters said they are starting to set aside their frustrations to coalesce around the party’s midterm candidates.

title: Politics chat: Trump's $5,000 promise to voters, Vance invokes Charlie Kirk
description: Following the midterm convention in Dallas, President Trump's $5,000 campaign promise has generated attention, but not belief. And, Vice President JD Vance characterizes Democrats as extremists.

title: The Social Security trust fund is running out. Why is it not a top campaign issue?
description: Limited public discussion of the trust fund's shortfall has experts worried that most Americans don't fully understand the problems Social Security faces — or weigh in on solutions.

title: Trump endorses Irish reunification, breaking with decades of U.S. policy
description: Trump’s comments broke with longstanding U.S. neutrality on the question of reuniting the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland — a highly sensitive issue in the U.K.
